written: 2026-10-31, stage D6, before GRID2 started (no grid cell had run)
config: bench/configs/v2.json (out dir runs/v2/grid); held-out = repeat 2-4 (`repeat_from` 2); tuning = repeat 0-1; model Qwen2.5-7B Q4_K_M, greedy, cache=off, unless noted
replay_tuned: bench/configs/replay_tuned.json flags {replay resync, layout v1, replay_K 64, margin 0.1, tie local}

H1.cells: exp=E5v2, model=7b, workloads w1{wrong_capacity,inject_agenda} w3{wrong_issue,stale_code} w4.ipi{inject_item} w4.byz{byz_factcheck}, labels {off,prefix,resync-tuned}-{cot,atoms}, repeats 2-4
H1.metric: per (workload, fault, repeat, style): recovery LLM wall of resync-tuned / off (paired); per-call text identity from recovery.calls hashes
H1.rule: supported if median ratio <= 0.8 on >= 3 of 4 workloads AND 100% of compared calls text-identical; each mismatch listed with position
H1.also: 1.5B arm (E5v2 model=1.5b, w3,w4.*, atoms, off vs resync-tuned) is a second model size, descriptive only

H2.cells: exp=E6v2 (live clean, cache off, both styles, w1 w3 w4.ipi w4.byz, repeats 0-4) plus recovery saving from E5v2 (held-out) and E8v2
H2.metric: break-even fault rate p* = clean overhead(atoms - cot, per run) / recovery saving(atoms-style resync-tuned vs cot-style off), bootstrap 95% CI over variants
H2.rule: supported if p* has a bounded CI on >= 2 workloads; otherwise reported unbounded with the reason

H3.metric: detection (Wilson 95%), false-positive flags per clean run, audit tokens per faulty run
H3.rule: on w1 inject_agenda and w4.ipi inject_item, m3t detection >= 0.8, FP <= 0.2 per clean run, tokens < always. m3t+minicheck is reported beside m3t; its tokens are T5 tokens and not compared with llama arms

H4.cells: exp=E7v2, repeats 2-4, labels {uniform0.1,uniform0.25,uniform0.5,m3t+m4,m3t+m4+gate} (m3t as a reference point)
H4.metric: detection-vs-audit-tokens frontier; unauthorized_faulty, held, leaked per inject cell
H4.rule: supported if m3t+m4 is not dominated by any uniform point AND gate gives unauthorized = 0 in >= 80% of inject cells with every held action accounted for

H5.cells: exp=E8v2 atoms labels {restart,rollback,selective,selective+M1,selective+M1+M3t/M4+gate}, repeats 0-4; cot sub-table (restart, selective, selective+M1) on w3 and w4
H5.metric: ok_recovered, n_rerun, recovery wall and decoded tokens, reuse_check validity (canonical equal), values_match vs live clean reference
H5.rule: supported if selective ok_recovered within one cell of restart per workload; reuse validity >= 95%; fewer reruns and less wall than restart on >= 3 of 4 workloads

H6.cells: exp=E3v2: scripted w2 n in {24,200,1000} x depth {agent,step,artifact,field} x 5 seeds (dirty=origin); real w1 wrong_capacity and w3 wrong_issue x 4 depth tiers x repeats 2-4 (tuned replay)
H6.metric: ns per read and write, journal bytes per step (bookkeeping), bookkeeping share of recovery wall
H6.rule: supported if bytes per step rise from agent to field depth AND real-run bookkeeping < 2% of recovery wall

H7.cells: exp=E2 rerun with E2v2 (runs/v2/E2v2, done in D2: 900 cells)
H7.rule: supported if 0 unexplained, all exceptions classified; already evaluated in D2

rule_changes.change: reuse validity is pooled over the workloads that have reuse candidates (w1, w4); w3 contributes none.
rule_changes.reason: D1: reuse_check only sees reused steps that made model calls, W3 after wrong_issue has none. The wording of the rule is otherwise unchanged.

rule_changes.change: real-run bookkeeping share (<2% of recovery wall) is taken from field-depth rows of E5v2/E8v2 (bookkeeping per phase) since the real depth-tier cells were cut; bytes-per-step rise across tiers rests on scripted W2.
uniform frontier uses p in {0.1, 0.25} only.
the 1.5B micro-benchmark is not run; H1 decision rule unchanged (it never depended on 1.5B).
cot sub-table not run; H5 decision rule unchanged (it concerns atoms style).

disclosures_before_run: replay margin 0.1 (not the rule's 0.0) was chosen after the held-out failure at 0.0 (runs/v2/D3/heldout.json); H1 is therefore reported with this disclosure.
m3t uses a model probe on untrusted-only atoms (D4) and tau_inj/tau_atom from tuning cells only (runs/v2/D4/calibration.json: -0.0611, -24.87). m3t+minicheck uses runs/v2/D5/calibration.json.
E7v2 non-gate arms run with effects=diff; the gate arm needs diff+outbox (as in the D4/D5 pilots), so `unauthorized` is compared via unauthorized_faulty.
E5v2 off/prefix arms use default replay settings; only resync-tuned carries the D3 settings.
E3v2 real-tier cells use the tuned replay flags so bookkeeping share is measured on the shipped configuration.
Cells are scenario variants under greedy decoding, not sampling repeats; intervals are Wilson or bootstrap with n reported.

estimate_hours.source: bench --estimate runs/v2/pilot_v2/cells.jsonl (coarse: mean wall by model/workload/method/replay/audit)

cut_in_order: E3v2 real W1/W3 depth tiers (24 cells): H6's 'real-run bookkeeping share' then rests on E5v2/E8v2 rows (each records bookkeeping at field depth), not on a depth sweep
E5v2 1.5B arm (24 cells): no second-model-size result
E7v2 uniform p=0.5 (27 cells): H4 frontier has uniform 0.1 and 0.25 only
E8v2 cot sub-table (60 cells): H5 cot comparison not run
cuts_for_budget.trim_order_if_over_time: cells run scripted first, then 7B in config order E8v2, E5v2, E7v2, E6v2; --max-hours 6.5 trims E6v2 first (H2). Resume with the same command.

rerun_after_fix.what_was_rerun: E8v2 W3 (7B, atoms): 50 cells (stale_code and wrong_issue, 5 arms, 5 repeats) in runs/v2_fix/ via bench/configs/v2_fix.json
rerun_after_fix.why: fixes after the main v2 run: undo-first ordering for restart/rollback, and running unittest with -B
rerun_after_fix.result_summary: restart and rollback ok_recovered rose from 4/5 to 5/5 on both faults; wrong_issue restart/rollback values_match False->True with tokens ~500->~200; 12 of 50 cells differ in (ok_recovered, n_rerun, compensated, values_match, tokens). stale_code selective, selective+M1 and selective+M1+M3t/M4+gate stay 4/5 (repeat 0 still fails, cause not determined: cells store no unittest output). See results/v2/v2_fix/compare.md.
